name: Many Ducks
detailed_description:
Waddle into a world of weird and wonderful ducks as the new Duck Rancher of Waddleton Cove! Build your ranch, hatch ducklings, and raise a flock worthy of leading the legendary Duck Parade. Explore ever-changing forests, befriend quirky townsfolk, and unearth rare duck breeds as you prepare the perfect float to dazzle the crowds each season.

  • Daily Duck Care – Collect and incubate a colorful clutch of eggs, then watch your new ducklings waddle into the world.

  • Revamp Your Ranch – Upgrade coops, feeding stations, and unlock specialized habitats to hatch rare breeds.

  • Homestead Decoration – Unlock decorative upgrades to make your ranch uniquely yours.

  • Ever‑Shifting Forest – Venture into a procedurally shifting forest landscape to discover hidden clearings and secret groves.

  • Duck Discovery – Search for new wild duck types: each with unique traits, colors, and abilities to add to your flock.

  • Secret Treasures – Unearth tokens, trophies, and rare resources tucked away in the forest’s nooks.

  • Town Festivals – Join in celebrations that occur once a month, each with its own theme, quests, and special events.

  • Float Crafting – Work with townsfolk to design a brand-new parade float each season, using trophies, tokens, and special items you've collected.

  • Parade Leader Selection – Choose your star duck to lead the town’s grand parade and earn the admiration of Waddleton Cove.

  • Meet the Heart of the Cove – Waddleton Cove is full of characters with big personalities and strong opinions about ducks. From Mayor Maggie and her assistant, Steve the Shrimp, to Mikhail at the Duck Emporium and his overly eager intern Tote, every conversation helps shape your story.

  • Every Word Matters – Relationships grow through friendly chats, helpful favors, and the occasional odd request. Your dialogue choices influence how others see you, and building trust with one character might unlock new possibilities with another.

  • More Than Just Friendship – A strong bond can lead to special quests, unique duck eggs, and tokens for float decorations. The right conversation at the right time might even lead you to a duck that no one else has seen.

⚠️ Early Development Notice ⚠️

Many Ducks is in its very early stages—gameplay systems are being refined and our art direction is still evolving. Expect fresh features, visuals, and polish in upcoming updates as Waddleton Cove grows.

Want a peek at how things are changing?

Here’s how our intern Tote looked then vs. now:

Add Many Ducks to your wishlist and be the first to embark on this quacking adventure in Waddleton Cove!

Follow us on social media and join our Discord server to see our progress and share feedback.

🚨🚨🚨 Beware of Scams! 🚨🚨🚨

Many Ducks is not currently available for public testing.

If anyone asks you to download a beta from an external website or sign up for early access, it is a scam — and could install malware on your device.

✅ The only place to access our game or participate in testing will be right here, through our official Steam page.
🦆 Please stay safe, and report any suspicious links or messages pretending to represent our team.

  • Storage: 5 GB available space
